messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm planning a backfill job to populate rotation metadata on ExternalSecrets so Vault can rotate tokens cleanly. Need a quick config + safety check before I run it.
sam: Which clusters and what's the order? staging first then prod?
maria: Yes. staging -> canary prod -> full prod. Backfill will set annotation and a ttl tag so it doesn't trigger immediate rotate.
jon: How are you avoiding double-rotation if an existing controller sees the change? any annotation to mark as backfilled?
maria: Good call. We'll add annotation `redwood.io/rotation-origin=backfill` and set `rotation_backfill: true` in the helm overlay for the job. Controller will ignore that annotation for automatic rotates.
infra-bot: job/sync-backfill created: jobs/sync-backfill-staging (job id: jb-20260318-7) :white_check_mark:
sam: Can you paste the helm/terraform bits here? quick glance
maria: Paste of overlay snippet:

```
# charts/externalsecrets/overlays/backfill-values.yaml
rotation:
  enabled: true
  backfill: true
  ttl_seconds: 2592000 # 30d
annotations:
  redwood.io/rotation-origin: backfill
```

And terraform var I toggled in the plan: `externalsecrets_backfill = true`
jon: Are we adding jitter to TTL so not all rotate at once? last time we saw a flurry of requests.
maria: Yes `ttl_jitter_seconds = 600` — job will randomize epoch when writing metadata.
sam: Lint check on the terraform changes? I can run `tflint` locally if you push the branch.
infra-bot: tfsec: no issues found. terraform fmt: ok. tflint: warning externalsecret_resource: use `data` block for secret refs.
maria: I'll address the tflint warning in the PR, it's just a recommended pattern. Also adding preflight: `kubectl get externalsecret --selector=app=payments -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'` to ensure we don't touch excluded namespaces.
devops-oncall: Ping me ~10m before you flip prod canary so I can watch token churn. Also ensure our alert for vault-requests-per-minute is silenced for the canary window.
maria: OK will @devops-oncall ten minutes before canary. PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/342 — includes job manifest, helm overlay, and terraform var. Please review :pray:
sam: I'll review this afternoon and comment on the tflint fix.
jon: I'll keep an eye on canary metrics. If token churn > 3x baseline roll back and notify infra channel.
maria: Thanks all :thumbsup: will run staging after review and report back here with job logs.
